title: Iron Man #11
desc:
FANTASTIC VS. INVINCIBLE!

TONY STARK is being monitored by the people closest to him...and that includes Marvel's First Family: THE FANTASTIC FOUR! Reed and Sue Richards have kept their distance, but it's finally time for them to face down the Armored Avenger!

What has IRON MAN been up to? And how will it lead him into becoming the INCARCERATED IRON MAN?!
